notes.label: Application timeframe
notes.text: It says both that: "Patients can submit Financial Assistance applications any time during the collection process." AND that "The Financial Assistance Counselor will, upon approving a patient for a Financial Assistance Discount, include any and all covered service accounts with open balances up to 240 days back from the date the patient completed the application and up to a maximum of 12 months forward. Accounts older than 240 days prior to the application date may be approved at the discretion of the Sr. Vice President, Revenue Cycle or designee." So, even though they say an application can be submitted at any time, there is an effective time frame.

notes.label: Document inconsistencies

Some documents go up to 400% of the FPL and some go up to 500% (the policy goes up to 500%, but this is confusing becasue 401% to 500% have to pay 100% of the fees, so this does not even seem like a discount)

ASSET CHECKS (on website): "Note: We reserve the right to request additional documentation related to resources for patients with household incomes under 150% of the federal poverty level."

notes.label: Application timeframe
notes.text:
IN POLICY/ SUMMARY: "Patients are encouraged to apply for Financial Assistance within ninety (90) days from the date noted on the first post-discharge billing statement; however, Northwell will accept Financial Assistance Applications at any time a patient has an outstanding balance for Emergency Medical Care or other Medically Necessary Services received at a Northwell Health hospital facility."
ON WEBSITE: "You are encouraged to apply for financial assistance within 90 days from the first post-discharge date noted on the statement; however, you are permitted a minimum of 240 days to apply and submit a completed application."

notes.label: Document inconsistencies
notes.text: Policy explicitly mentions that immigration status will not be a barrier to recieveing financial assitance, however the online application asks for SSN (it does allow the option of putting "None" but they in general should not be asking for it). The FPL numbers everywhere is correctly 2025 but it is just sometimes incorrectly labeled as 2024. Some documents go up to 400% of the FPL and some go up to 500% (the policy goes up to 500%, but this is confusing becasue 401% to 500% have to pay 100% of the fees, so this does not even seem like a discount)

notes.label: Review notes
notes.text: The policy has the CORRECT definition of Underinsured: "Underinsured: The patient is not Uninsured and has out-of-pocket medical costs accumulated in the past 12 months for Emergency Medical Care or other Medically Necessary Services that amount to more than 10% of the individual’s annual gross income." ASSET CHECKS (on website): "Note: We reserve the right to request additional documentation related to resources for patients with household incomes under 150% of the federal poverty level."

notes.text: PDF of application is uniform, but their online application is not and requests SSN

notes.label: Additional findings
notes.text: "If you are a New York state resident, you may qualify for financial assistance or the sliding fee discount if you submit an application and if we determine that you are eligible"

notes.text:
IN POLICY/ SUMMARY: "Patients are encouraged to apply for Financial Assistance within ninety (90) days from the date noted on the first post-discharge billing statement; however, Northwell will accept Financial Assistance Applications at any time a patient has an outstanding balance for Emergency Medical Care or other Medically Necessary Services received at a Northwell Health hospital facility."

notes.label: Document inconsistencies
notes.text: Policy explicitly mentions that immigration status will not be a barrier to recieveing financial assitance, however the online application asks for SSN (it does allow the option of putting "None" but they in general should not be asking for it). The FPL numbers everywhere is correctly 2025 but it is just sometimes incorrectly labeled as 2024. Some documents go up to 400% of the FPL and some go up to 500% (the policy goes up to 500%, but this is confusing becasue 401% to 500% have to pay 100% of the fees, so this does not even seem like a discount)

notes.label: Review notes
notes.text: The policy has the CORRECT definition of Underinsured: "Underinsured: The patient is not Uninsured and has out-of-pocket medical costs accumulated in the past 12 months for Emergency Medical Care or other Medically Necessary Services that amount to more than 10% of the individual’s annual gross income." ASSET CHECKS (on website): "Note: We reserve the right to request additional documentation related to resources for patients with household incomes under 150% of the federal poverty level."

notes.label: Additional findings

notes.label: Application timeframe
notes.text:
IN POLICY/ SUMMARY: "Patients are encouraged to apply for Financial Assistance within ninety (90) days from the date noted on the first post-discharge billing statement; however, Northwell will accept Financial Assistance Applications at any time a patient has an outstanding balance for Emergency Medical Care or other Medically Necessary Services received at a Northwell Health hospital facility."
ON WEBSITE: "You are encouraged to apply for financial assistance within 90 days from the first post-discharge date noted on the statement; however, you are permitted a minimum of 240 days to apply and submit a completed application."

notes.label: Document inconsistencies
notes.text: Policy explicitly mentions that immigration status will not be a barrier to recieveing financial assitance, however the online application asks for SSN (it does allow the option of putting "None" but they in general should not be asking for it). The FPL numbers everywhere is correctly 2025 but it is just sometimes incorrectly labeled as 2024. Some documents go up to 400% of the FPL and some go up to 500% (the policy goes up to 500%, but this is confusing becasue 401% to 500% have to pay 100% of the fees, so this does not even seem like a discount)

notes.label: Review notes
notes.text: The policy has the CORRECT definition of Underinsured: "Underinsured: The patient is not Uninsured and has out-of-pocket medical costs accumulated in the past 12 months for Emergency Medical Care or other Medically Necessary Services that amount to more than 10% of the individual’s annual gross income." ASSET CHECKS (on website): "Note: We reserve the right to request additional documentation related to resources for patients with household incomes under 150% of the federal poverty level."

notes.label: Application notes
notes.text: PDF of application is uniform, but their online application is not and requests SSN

notes.label: Summary notes
notes.text: The income levels table uses 2025 FPL guidelines (cross checked this) but inconsistently refers to them as both 2024 FPL cutoffs and 2025 FPL cutoffs

notes.label: Additional findings
notes.text: "If you are a New York state resident, you may qualify for financial assistance or the sliding fee discount if you submit an application and if we determine that you are eligible"

notes.label: Application timeframe
notes.text:
IN POLICY/ SUMMARY: "Patients are encouraged to apply for Financial Assistance within ninety (90) days from the date noted on the first post-discharge billing statement; however, Northwell will accept Financial Assistance Applications at any time a patient has an outstanding balance for Emergency Medical Care or other Medically Necessary Services received at a Northwell Health hospital facility."
ON WEBSITE: "You are encouraged to apply for financial assistance within 90 days from the first post-discharge date noted on the statement; however, you are permitted a minimum of 240 days to apply and submit a completed application."

notes.label: Document inconsistencies
notes.text: Policy explicitly mentions that immigration status will not be a barrier to recieveing financial assitance, however the online application asks for SSN (it does allow the option of putting "None" but they in general should not be asking for it). The FPL numbers everywhere is correctly 2025 but it is just sometimes incorrectly labeled as 2024. Some documents go up to 400% of the FPL and some go up to 500% (the policy goes up to 500%, but this is confusing becasue 401% to 500% have to pay 100% of the fees, so this does not even seem like a discount)

notes.label: Review notes
notes.text: The policy has the CORRECT definition of Underinsured: "Underinsured: The patient is not Uninsured and has out-of-pocket medical costs accumulated in the past 12 months for Emergency Medical Care or other Medically Necessary Services that amount to more than 10% of the individual’s annual gross income." ASSET CHECKS (on website): "Note: We reserve the right to request additional documentation related to resources for patients with household incomes under 150% of the federal poverty level."

notes.label: Application notes
notes.text: PDF of application is uniform, but their online application is not and requests SSN

notes.label: Summary notes
notes.text: The income levels table uses 2025 FPL guidelines (cross checked this) but inconsistently refers to them as both 2024 FPL cutoffs and 2025 FPL cutoffs

notes.label: Additional findings
notes.text: "If you are a New York state resident, you may qualify for financial assistance or the sliding fee discount if you submit an application and if we determine that you are eligible"

notes.label: Application timeframe
notes.text: It says both that: "Patients can submit Financial Assistance applications any time during the collection process." AND that "The Financial Assistance Counselor will, upon approving a patient for a Financial Assistance Discount, include any and all covered service accounts with open balances up to 240 days back from the date the patient completed the application and up to a maximum of 12 months forward. Accounts older than 240 days prior to the application date may be approved at the discretion of the Sr. Vice President, Revenue Cycle or designee." So, even though they say an application can be submitted at any time, there is an effective time frame.

notes.label: Application timeframe
notes.text:
IN POLICY/ SUMMARY: "Patients are encouraged to apply for Financial Assistance within ninety (90) days from the date noted on the first post-discharge billing statement; however, Northwell will accept Financial Assistance Applications at any time a patient has an outstanding balance for Emergency Medical Care or other Medically Necessary Services received at a Northwell Health hospital facility."
ON WEBSITE: "You are encouraged to apply for financial assistance within 90 days from the first post-discharge date noted on the statement; however, you are permitted a minimum of 240 days to apply and submit a completed application."

notes.label: Document inconsistencies
notes.text: Policy explicitly mentions that immigration status will not be a barrier to recieveing financial assitance, however the online application asks for SSN (it does allow the option of putting "None" but they in general should not be asking for it). The FPL numbers everywhere is correctly 2025 but it is just sometimes incorrectly labeled as 2024. Some documents go up to 400% of the FPL and some go up to 500% (the policy goes up to 500%, but this is confusing becasue 401% to 500% have to pay 100% of the fees, so this does not even seem like a discount)

notes.label: Review notes
notes.text: The policy has the CORRECT definition of Underinsured: "Underinsured: The patient is not Uninsured and has out-of-pocket medical costs accumulated in the past 12 months for Emergency Medical Care or other Medically Necessary Services that amount to more than 10% of the individual’s annual gross income." ASSET CHECKS (on website): "Note: We reserve the right to request additional documentation related to resources for patients with household incomes under 150% of the federal poverty level."

notes.label: Application notes
notes.text: PDF of application is uniform, but their online application is not and requests SSN

notes.label: Summary notes
notes.text: The income levels table uses 2025 FPL guidelines (cross checked this) but inconsistently refers to them as both 2024 FPL cutoffs and 2025 FPL cutoffs

notes.label: Additional findings
notes.text: "If you are a New York state resident, you may qualify for financial assistance or the sliding fee discount if you submit an application and if we determine that you are eligible"

notes.text:
IN POLICY/ SUMMARY: "Patients are encouraged to apply for Financial Assistance within ninety (90) days from the date noted on the first post-discharge billing statement; however, Northwell will accept Financial Assistance Applications at any time a patient has an outstanding balance for Emergency Medical Care or other Medically Necessary Services received at a Northwell Health hospital facility."

notes.label: Document inconsistencies

notes.label: Summary notes
notes.text: The income levels table uses 2025 FPL guidelines (cross checked this) but inconsistently refers to them as both 2024 FPL cutoffs and 2025 FPL cutoffs

notes.label: Additional findings
notes.text: "If you are a New York state resident, you may qualify for financial assistance or the sliding fee discount if you submit an application and if we determine that you are eligible"

notes.label: Application timeframe
notes.text:
IN POLICY/ SUMMARY: "Patients are encouraged to apply for Financial Assistance within ninety (90) days from the date noted on the first post-discharge billing statement; however, Northwell will accept Financial Assistance Applications at any time a patient has an outstanding balance for Emergency Medical Care or other Medically Necessary Services received at a Northwell Health hospital facility."
ON WEBSITE: "You are encouraged to apply for financial assistance within 90 days from the first post-discharge date noted on the statement; however, you are permitted a minimum of 240 days to apply and submit a completed application."

notes.label: Document inconsistencies
notes.text: Policy explicitly mentions that immigration status will not be a barrier to recieveing financial assitance, however the online application asks for SSN (it does allow the option of putting "None" but they in general should not be asking for it). The FPL numbers everywhere is correctly 2025 but it is just sometimes incorrectly labeled as 2024. Some documents go up to 400% of the FPL and some go up to 500% (the policy goes up to 500%, but this is confusing becasue 401% to 500% have to pay 100% of the fees, so this does not even seem like a discount)

notes.label: Review notes
notes.text: PDF of application is uniform, but their online application is not and requests SSN

notes.label: Summary notes
notes.text: The income levels table uses 2025 FPL guidelines (cross checked this) but inconsistently refers to them as both 2024 FPL cutoffs and 2025 FPL cutoffs

notes.label: Additional findings
notes.text: "If you are a New York state resident, you may qualify for financial assistance or the sliding fee discount if you submit an application and if we determine that you are eligible"
